Stickers prints labels on Herma laser sheets. Click Stickers in the toolbar.
Choose the sheet. The preview shows the sheet exactly as the printer will print it.
Choose what to print: cable labels, panel connection labels, node ports, racks and devices, fibres, network cables and switch ports.
Every sticker has the colour of its node, so you can see where a cable goes. Cables get two labels, one for each end.
If the sheet is already partly used, set the first label to start with, and use the rest.
The calibration sheet prints outlines only. Print it on a real sheet and hold it to the light, to check that every label sits where the template says.
